summary: Completed Module 1 FIX by formalizing the trust-calibration workflow: AI outputs are treated as hypotheses, verified against repository evidence, and classified before acceptance.
evidence: Updated `progress/trust-audit.md` with a dedicated FIX process-improvement section.
Process rule 1 recorded: AI-generated architectural claims are hypotheses, not facts, until evidence confirms them.
Process rule 2 recorded: validate claims with repository evidence first (targeted file/search commands and sanity checks).
Process rule 3 recorded: classify claims as TRUST, VERIFY, or SUSPICIOUS before acceptance and reuse.
Process rule 4 recorded: keep an explicit audit trail (claim, check command, observed output summary, corrected truth, classification).
Linked to BREAK outcome: the wrong claim was disproved and classified as SUSPICIOUS, and this policy now prevents similar overconfident-claim acceptance in future modules.
No application code was modified during FIX; only `progress/trust-audit.md` was updated as process evidence.
